5.6 Investigation Outcomes and Evaluation 
For study 20 students were evenly divided between the proposed gamified 
short-form content application and the traditional Bitesize e-learning platform. 
 
Figure 56 Lesson Completion Times 
The collected data shows that both platforms lesson durations were within the 
recommended 5–to-15-minute range (Barana, et al., 2019; Brame, 2016; Ilona 
& Henrike, 2010). With the proposed applications average lesson duration at 5.4 
minutes, and Bitesize at 7.3 minutes.  
The interquartile range of Bitesize is notably larger than the proposed 
application, signifying evidence towards an irregular learning experience. This 
could be caused by the content primarily being text focused, resulting in 
different comprehension and reading rates among the students. The smaller 
interquartile range for the proposed application, is likely attributed to the fact 
that videos are displayed, making the only varying factor the time taken to 
complete a question.
